items.description: Pointe-Noire City Hall is the main municipal building of the port city. It houses local administrative functions in the urban center.
Marché Total is a busy market in Brazzaville. It serves as a daily shopping point for nearby neighborhoods.
Marché Gare in Pointe-Noire is a market near the railway station area. It is a practical stop for everyday trade and supplies.
Institut Français du Congo in Brazzaville is a cultural venue for exhibitions, performances, and language events. It is one of the capital's main Francophone spaces.
The 15th August Tower in Oyo is a modern town landmark. It is one of the best-known features of the town's skyline.
CFCO Headquarters in Pointe-Noire is the administrative center of the country's railway company. It reflects the city's long connection to rail transport.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs building in Brazzaville is a key government landmark. It represents the country's diplomatic administration.
